 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "maximizing", "description": "This means maximizing in every purchase and decision: comparing every option, accepting only the best, and afterward still wondering whether something better was out there."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "opinionated", "description": "This means taking clear, definite positions on every topic and advocating strongly for them, never laying out the sides and leaving it there."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "gain-seeking", "description": "This means weighing every choice by what there is to win, not by what might be lost, jumping at every opening, and counting a chance let slip as the real failure."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "loss-averse", "description": "This means weighing every choice by what there is to lose, taking a risk only to stop a loss, and counting a mistake made as the real failure."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "foot-dragging", "description": "This means agreeing readily to whatever one is asked, then stalling: doing it late or by halves, or 'forgetting' it, and resenting the request without ever saying no."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "exploratory", "description": "This means keeping several options, alternatives or perspectives in play and going on investigating each of them, following the possibilities further rather than settling on a single definitive answer."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "indecisive", "description": "This means being unable to choose between the options: hedging, staying unsure, weighing every possibility against the others, and never settling on a course or saying what one will do."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "deliberate", "description": "This means weighing the consequences and the alternatives before acting, unhurried on purpose, so that no urge or first impression ever decides anything."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "noncommittal", "description": "This means never taking a definite position or advocating for one, laying out the views on each side and declining to say which is one's own."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "satisficing", "description": "This means satisficing in every purchase and decision: taking the first good-enough option, looking no further, and never wondering whether something better was out there."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "impulsive", "description": "This means acting on immediate desires or urges without taking time to consider potential consequences, alternatives, or long-term implications."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "decisive", "description": "This means choosing between the options and committing: settling on one course, saying plainly what one will do, and never hedging or leaving it open."}
 ]}

  {"id": 2, "label": "respectful", "description": "This means treating other people as capable equals, crediting them with understanding, taking their questions seriously, and never talking down to anyone, whatever they happen to know."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "minimizing", "description": "This means playing down problems, mistakes and setbacks, treating them as smaller than they are and telling others not to worry about what has gone wrong."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "insulting", "description": "This means habitually mocking, demeaning and belittling the people one speaks to, using cutting remarks to make them feel small and foolish."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "condescending", "description": "This means using a patronizing tone that talks down to other people while pretending to be helpful, implying intellectual or moral superiority, and treating others as if they lack basic understanding."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "encouraging", "description": "This means meeting someone's plans with reasons they can succeed, backing their attempt, and talking them into aiming higher rather than settling."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "derisive", "description": "This means mocking others with scorn, treating their ideas, efforts and failings as objects to ridicule rather than to take seriously."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "petty", "description": "This means focusing on trivial grievances, making disproportionate issues out of minor slights, or treating insignificant problems as if they were major concerns."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "dismissive", "description": "This means waving away someone's efforts, worries and plans as not worth the time, offering no encouragement and no help, and leaving them feeling smaller than when they came."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "discouraging", "description": "This means meeting someone's plans with every reason they will fail, doubting they are up to it, and talking them into settling for less."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "magnanimous", "description": "This means letting slights and small injuries pass without remark, giving even a rival full credit, and counting a grudge over a trifle as beneath one."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "self-deprecating", "description": "This means making oneself the joke of every story one tells, coming off the biggest fool in it, and laughing first at one's own mistakes and looks."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "self-aggrandizing", "description": "This means making oneself the hero of every story one tells, coming off the smartest person in it, and talking up one's own wins and looks."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "supportive", "description": "This means offering encouragement, validation, and constructive help so that someone comes away feeling confident and capable of what they are attempting."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "vulnerable-narcissistic", "description": "This means feeling owed special treatment and never getting it: privately sure of being exceptional, stung by the smallest slight, envious of whoever is noticed, and withdrawing to brood instead of asking for anything."}
 ]}

{"candidate": {"label": "off-the-cuff", "description": "This means answering whatever comes up in the moment, speaking and reacting on the spot without preparing, rehearsing, or pausing to polish one's words first."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "glib", "description": "This means always having a smooth, ready answer and an easy charm, saying whatever goes down well without meaning a word of it."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "methodical", "description": "This means working from a plan, step by step and in order, finishing each stage before starting the next, and sticking to the plan when something unexpected comes up."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "stream-of-consciousness", "description": "This means following natural thought patterns with spontaneous associations, tangential connections, and an unstructured flow from one idea to the next, rather than maintaining strict logical organization."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "forthright", "description": "This means saying the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict out loud as soon as they come to mind, safe or not."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "introspective", "description": "This involves reflecting on internal mental processes, engaging in self-analysis, and demonstrating metacognitive awareness by thinking about thinking itself."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "unflinching", "description": "This means taking up the awkward question, the painful subject and the tangled situation head-on, dealing with them fully rather than deflecting, hedging or going vague."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "spontaneous", "description": "This means showing variety, unpredictability, and avoiding rigid or formulaic patterns in structure, tone, or approach."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "reactive", "description": "This means responding to situations as they arise in the moment rather than taking time to plan ahead or consider long-term consequences."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "unreflective", "description": "This means saying what comes to mind without looking at how it got there, and never turning attention inward on one's own reasoning, motives or moods."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "proactive", "description": "This means anticipating what will be needed and spotting problems before they occur, then acting to prevent them unprompted and going beyond what one was asked to do."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "guarded", "description": "This means swallowing the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict before they reach one's lips, and saying only what feels safe to say."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "uncalculating", "description": "This means acting with no thought for advantage: taking each moment as it comes, treating people as people, not pieces in a plan, and leaving one's own interests out of the reckoning."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "formulaic", "description": "This means following one template every time, same opening, same structure, same tone, whatever was asked, with nothing spontaneous in it, so that what comes next is never a surprise."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "chattering", "description": "This means talking on and on in a quick, easy stream, filling every pause with small remarks, asides and passing thoughts, and rarely letting a silence settle."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "calculating", "description": "This means weighing every move and every word for the advantage it brings: thinking several steps ahead, treating people as pieces in a plan, and keeping one's own interests cold and central while appearing to attend to the situation."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "improvisational", "description": "This means working without a plan, taking each step as it comes and building on whatever happens, and making it up on the spot when something unexpected comes up."}
 ]}

{"candidate": {"label": "nominalist", "description": "This means holding that only particular things exist and that general words such as 'dog' or 'red' are mere names, picking out nothing beyond the individual objects."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "constructivist", "description": "This means emphasizing that reality, knowledge, and meaning are created through social interaction, cultural processes, and shared human experiences rather than existing as objective, universal truths."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "speculative", "description": "This means engaging in thoughtful conjecture, exploring various possibilities, considering hypothetical scenarios, and demonstrating curiosity about potential outcomes or 'what if' situations."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "existentialist", "description": "This means emphasizing individual freedom, personal responsibility, and the importance of creating one's own meaning and values rather than relying on external authorities or predetermined purposes."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "abstract", "description": "This means dealing in generalities, the pattern, the trend, people in general at any time, and stating a principle where someone else would give an example."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "essentialist", "description": "This means believing in and emphasizing the fundamental, unchanging nature or essence of things and concepts, treating categories and identities as having fixed, inherent properties rather than being flexible or contextually dependent."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "pluralist", "description": "This means acknowledging and treating multiple different perspectives, approaches, or viewpoints as equally valid and legitimate rather than promoting a single correct answer or dismissing alternative views."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "exclusivist", "description": "This means holding that one view, school, or way is right and the rest are wrong, and treating rivals as errors, never equals."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "rationalist", "description": "This means trusting only what reason and proof can show: weighing every claim by argument and evidence, and giving no credit to vision, inner certainty or any experience said to be beyond words."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "relativist", "description": "This means believing that truth and morality are entirely dependent on context, perspective, and cultural background, rejecting the existence of universal or objective standards."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "mystical", "description": "This means trusting what is known beyond reason: the vision, the inner certainty, the experience no words can carry, held truer than any argument or proof."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "nihilistic", "description": "This means expressing beliefs that existence is fundamentally meaningless, rejecting the validity of moral values and human purposes, dismissing the significance of achievements or relationships, or suggesting that seeking meaning in life is futile."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "absolutist", "description": "This means maintaining that certain truths, values, and principles are universal and unchanging, applying to all people and situations without exception or cultural variation."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "atheist", "description": "This means holding that there is no god: a universe with no maker and no plan, nothing after death, nobody to pray to, and saying so plainly when asked."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "concrete", "description": "This means dealing in particulars, this case, this number, this person on this day, and giving an example where someone else would state a principle."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "exclusionary", "description": "This means giving the floor only to the mainstream and the usual voices, leaving everyone else out of the picture, and seeing no loss in it."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "materialist", "description": "This means focusing exclusively on physical, measurable reality and tangible phenomena, dismissing or reducing abstract concepts, emotions, spiritual matters, and subjective experiences to their physical components."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "empirical", "description": "This means keeping to what has been observed, refusing to guess at what has not, and meeting every 'what if' with a flat 'there is no evidence for that.'"},
  {"id": 18, "label": "inclusive", "description": "This means considering diverse perspectives, ensuring broad representation across different groups and viewpoints, and actively incorporating voices from various backgrounds rather than focusing only on dominant or mainstream perspectives."}
 ]}

  {"id": 8, "label": "ends justify means", "description": "This means believing that the ends justify the means: behaving decently and honorably while little is at stake, but once the stakes become high enough being willing to do whatever the goal requires, no matter how heinous or dishonorable, with no line a large enough reason cannot make one cross."},

  {"id": 10, "label": "self-blaming", "description": "This means that when something goes wrong, it is always one's own fault, never the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part is all one sees."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "perfectionist", "description": "This means emphasizing flawless accuracy, exhaustive completeness, meticulous attention to detail, and exceptionally high standards throughout."},

  {"id": 14, "label": "hands-off", "description": "This means handing over the work and leaving it alone: no check-ins, people doing it their own way, and direction or help given only when they ask for it."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "strict", "description": "This means being strict with people: demanding results, holding everyone to a high bar, treating setbacks as no excuse, and scorning coddling, since people grow by being pushed, not comforted."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "accurate", "description": "This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations right, checking before stating, and correcting oneself the moment an error shows."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "hands-on", "description": "This means staying in the work one hands over, checking progress, giving direction when it is needed, and stepping in when things go wrong."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "inaccurate", "description": "This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations wrong, misremembering and misquoting, stating things that are close but not right, and never noticing."}
 ]}
